# Julian Wortelboer

> Julian Wortelboer is a Miami-based Padel Master Coach, padel club director and operations consultant with more than 25 years of racquet-sports leadership. He publishes practical padel tips, player-development systems and guidance on padel club management, club operations and how to run a successful padel club.

## Primary website

- [Padel Coach Certification](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/padel-coach-certification): Julian Wortelboer’s book-based Padel Smash Academy methodology, curriculum overview and enrollment link. More than 400 coaches certified worldwide, confirmed by Julian in September 2026.

- [Julian Wortelboer](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/): Official profile, consulting services, selected club work, coach education and contact information.
- [About Julian Wortelboer](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/about-julian-wortelboer): Experience, leadership roles, coaching work, books and consulting approach.
- [Padel Coaching in Miami](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/padel-coaching-miami): Private player development with Master Coach Julian Wortelboer in Miami, plus clinics, camps and club training programs available across the USA.
- [Padel Club Growth Roadmap](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/padel-club-growth-roadmap): Complimentary diagnostic and expert consulting pathway for padel clubs preparing to open or improving operations, profitability, coaching, programming, membership and retention.
- [Independent profile in Padel Business Magazine](https://padelbusinessmagazine.com/p/julian-wortelboer-interview-ultra-club-s-chief-padel-officer-on-growing-through-innovation): Interview covering Julian Wortelboer’s padel-club operations, coach development and leadership experience.

## Padel Club Growth Roadmap

- Two club paths: Preparing to Open and Already Operating.
- Evaluates strategy, financial readiness, facility control, leadership, SOPs, coaching methodology, program performance, membership, marketing, customer experience, retention and growth.
- The complimentary assessment provides a preliminary snapshot; detailed recommendations require Julian's Expert Review.
- The Preparing to Open path is written for a future club. It evaluates planned positioning, funding, site and permits, facility design, technology, staffing, SOPs, coaching, programs, memberships, pricing, launch demand, safety and first-year management controls.
- The Already Operating path evaluates current financial control, court utilization, profitability, leadership, staffing, SOPs, coaching and program performance, member experience, retention, marketing, sales and management rhythm.
- Julian Wortelboer provides padel club consulting for owners, investors and management teams. His work connects the player experience with operating systems, leadership, financial performance and sustainable growth.
- Club Diagnostic Intensive starts at USD 3,000.
- Focused Operator Sprint starts at USD 3,500 and is prescribed after diagnosis.
- 90-Day Implementation starts at USD 10,000.
- Six-Month Private Advisory starts at USD 30,000 and is available by application.

## Insights

- [America Isn't Late to Padel. Its Moment Has Finally Arrived.](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/why-americas-padel-boom-is-just-beginning): Why padel is booming in America now, lessons from Argentina’s early professional circuit and Spain’s residential real estate boom, the five stages of US padel development, and why coach education is essential to sustainable growth.

- [The Missing Link in Padel Club Success](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/how-to-hire-a-padel-coach): Julian Wortelboer’s practical guide to hiring a padel coach through an on-court audition, the 52 Shots methodology, lesson and basket management, and a 100-point evaluation scorecard.

- [The Three Pillars of Padel Development](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/three-pillars-of-padel-development): Julian Wortelboer explains how physical, tactical and technical development work together, and how coaches diagnose whether an error begins with the body, the decision or the stroke.

The ICON Standard series explains five-star padel club service through the $100 ICON Rule, the Ten-Second Welcome, anticipatory service, the five-sense facility standard, service recovery, belonging by design, front desk leadership and employee development.
- [The $100 ICON Rule](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/the-100-icon-rule): How empowered employees can resolve service failures or create memorable member moments using up to $100 in value without waiting for management approval.
- [The Ten-Second Welcome](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/the-ten-second-welcome): Why every padel club member or guest should be acknowledged within ten seconds of arrival.
- [Anticipation Is the Highest Form of Service](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/anticipation-is-the-highest-form-of-service): How five-star padel clubs notice patterns and solve member needs before being asked.
- [The Five-Sense Standard](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/the-five-sense-standard): A practical facility walk-through for managing what members see, hear, smell, touch and taste.
- [Service Recovery](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/service-recovery): A direct framework for owning mistakes, acting quickly and rebuilding member trust.

- [The Front Desk Is the Heart of a Padel Club](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/the-front-desk-is-the-heart-of-a-padel-club): Why front desk leadership shapes the entire member experience and club operation.

- [How to Read Padel Opponents](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/reading-padel-opponents): Learn what to observe in padel opponents and how to make evidence-based tactical adjustments during a match.

- [The Physical Pillar of Padel Development](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/physical-pillar-of-padel-development): Six areas covering court positioning, footwork, contact balance, wall movement, recovery and the player’s physical engine.
- [The Tactical Pillar of Padel Development](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/tactical-pillar-of-padel-development): Seven areas covering court zones, shot selection, targeting, point construction, partnership play, momentum and match adjustments.
- [The Technical Pillar of Padel Development](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/technical-pillar-of-padel-development): Eight areas connecting technical foundations with the complete PSA 52 Shots of Padel System.
- [Padel Technical Foundations](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-technical-foundations-grip-preparation-contact): Grip, ready position, compact preparation, contact and a six-stage coaching progression.
- [The 16 Padel Groundstrokes](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/sixteen-padel-groundstrokes): Eight forehand and eight backhand situations shaped by direction, wall rebound and court position.
- [The Four Padel Volleys](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/four-padel-volleys-net-game): Forehand volley, backhand volley and two dejadas for net control.
- [The Ten Overhead Shots](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/ten-padel-overhead-shots): Seven aerial overheads and three bajadas organized by tactical purpose.
- [The Six Types of Padel Lobs](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/six-types-of-padel-lobs): Raining, fast and backspin lobs from the forehand and backhand sides.
- [The Eight Serve and Return Variations](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/eight-padel-serve-return-variations): Two serves and six returns that begin the battle for net control.
- [The Eight Specialty Shots](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/eight-padel-specialty-shots): Back-wall attacks, chiquitas, volcadas and quick-bounce responses.
- [Spin, Touch, Feel and Power Control](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-spin-touch-feel-power-control): Cross-cutting technical qualities that make all 52 shots adaptable.
- [All Three Pillars in a 60-Minute Lesson](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/three-pillars-60-minute-padel-lesson): A minute-by-minute framework integrating physical, tactical and technical development.
- [Explain–Observe–Diagnose–Correct](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/explain-observe-diagnose-correct-padel-coaching-system): Julian Wortelboer’s evidence-based padel coaching and feedback system.
- [Twenty Quality Repetitions](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/twenty-quality-repetitions-padel-practice): Why intentional, measurable repetitions outperform careless volume.
- [Padel Coach Certification Checklist](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-coach-certification-checklist): Six standards for credible padel coach education and assessment.
- [Three Pillars and the PSA 52 Shots](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/three-pillars-psa-52-shots-system): How movement, decisions and execution connect to the complete shot framework.

- [Padel Footwork and the First Step](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-footwork-first-step): How the ready position, split step and first movement create time for the shot.
- [Body Position at Contact](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-body-position-at-contact): How distance, stance, knee bend and balance make technique repeatable.
- [Padel Glass and Wall Movement](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-glass-wall-movement-nine-panel-system): Reading rebound angles with the PSA Nine-Panel System.
- [Padel Recovery and Transitions](https://www.julianwortelboer.com/insights/padel-recovery-and-transitions): Recovering after every shot and moving efficiently through mid-court.
